g.text: predicted from the boiling point (Pa, log scale) →

svg.text: x: P = 1 atm · exp(−(ΔS/R)(Tb/T − 1)) with one ΔS for every liquid (the median of the non-donors), so the only input is the boiling point; y: the vapour pressure Wikidata reports.
Dashed: a factor of 2 either way. Across nine orders of magnitude the boiling point alone gets most liquids within a factor of 2 (legend), which is why shortcut distillation design
starts from boiling points; the O–H donors fall below the band. Hover a dot; click it for its Wikidata item and the source of each value.
